title: Sardinian Beurre-Noisette Pasta
description: A simple yet flavorful Italian dish featuring Sardinian-style saut5ed pasta, beurre-noisette, and a hint of brininess. This pescatarian-friendly meal is perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a copper pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the anchovy paste and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the butter and let it melt, then stir in the lemon zest and juice.
Season with Sardinian sea salt and black pepper.
Add the cooked pasta to the pot and toss everything together until the pasta is well coated with the beurre-noisette sauce.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
Be sure to serve immediately for the best flavor and texture.
If desired, add a sprinkle of extra virgin olive oil on top of the pasta for added richness.
Adjust the seasoning as needed before serving.
